verdict.rationale: Docs mention automatic handling and tracking of bounces, complaints, and unsubscribes to maintain a clean list (mailgun-docs-12, mailgun-docs-34), implying suppression list management exists, but the evidence pack never cites specific API endpoints or docs for reading/managing suppression lists (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes) via API calls. Missing for 10: explicit API reference docs for suppression list endpoints (GET/DELETE bounces, complaints, unsubscribes), code examples showing programmatic suppression management, and independent confirmation that re-sending to a suppressed address is blocked.
